Smart Home Index lists **{model}** as discontinued. You run {count}: {devices}.

They keep working, but expect no new firmware. The manufacturer's successor is **{replacement}**.

[Compare the two on Smart Home Index]({compare_url}) · [View {replacement}]({replacement_url})
